title: github.branch.create_from_changes v1 arguments
description: EffectDescriptor.arguments for effect_type github.branch.create_from_changes (HELM-753). The target is github.com/{owner}/{repo}; the repository comes only from the target, never from these arguments. The adapter creates the blobs, the tree, a commit whose only parent is base_sha, and then refs/heads/{head}, which must not exist yet. The gateway digests the exact argument bytes, so a client sends the bytes it later shows. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, and the gateway enforces before admission: no duplicate object keys; UTF-8 only; the whole document is at most 65536 bytes; paths are NFC, unique, and contain no empty, '.' or '..' segment; head passes git check-ref-format, starts with the mandate's branch prefix and is not the repository's default branch.

base.description: The branch the change is based on, for display; base_sha is what binds.

base_sha.description: The only parent of the new commit.

head.description: The branch to create. It must not exist.

files.description: Files added or replaced relative to base_sha. v1 has no deletes, symlinks, submodules or binary content.

content_utf8.description: The file content. At most 49152 characters here; the gateway also caps it at 49152 bytes.

x-helm.idempotent: conditional: the ref is created only if it does not exist
x-helm.observable: yes: ref, parents, compared paths and blob SHA-1s are read back
x-helm.reversible: yes: deleting the branch (not part of v1)
